author: DoctorTechy
body:
Hello, my name is DoctorTechy, formerly Technozoom17. On October 6th, 2014 I was banned from your server by Joao_Victor for using a flying hack. I can admit that it was foolish of me to attempt to use a hacked client on a multiplayer game, and I have now come to realize that it ruins the fun and challenge of games like this. With that being nearly a year and a half ago, I have learned that cheating is wrong, and I wish to be unbanned, and I promise that I will never use hacked clients again.

Thank you for considering,
-Techy

P.S. My Minecraft Username is DoctorTechy, but at the time of my ban it was either Technozoom17 or Techyzum17.

title: Infraction Appeal for DoctorTechy

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, DoctorTechy.

It appears to me that you have learned from your mistake and that you really wish to come back to the server. Seeing as you have not attempted to evade your punishment and met the waiting requirement of six months post-punishment, I will be appealing your infraction.

That being said, welcome back to the server. Make sure to abide by our ruleset this time around and remember to have fun, that is, without making use of any clients that give you unfair advantage against others.

Sincerely,
- timaeusTestified | Senior Moderator
